checked_classes: Ordering errors — checked stated execution order 1→2→6→7→8→3→4→5 and task dependency annotations; later gateway-editor propagation is explicitly deferred to Gate C while Gate U is scoped to an already operational gateway, and platform installed gates are correctly after installer creation.

Missing dependencies — checked each goal against task coverage: UAR storage/full-pack discovery, dedicated settings/i18n, progress/logs/recovery, Compass/gateway administration, UAR REST admin/catalog/#296, publication, installed acceptance, and lifecycle closeout all have corresponding plan sections and tasks.

Untestable or ambiguous acceptance criteria — checked Gates A/R/U/V/B/C/D and closeout criteria; each names concrete integrated scenarios, artifacts, platforms, and failure cases rather than generic pass/fail language.

Scope smuggling — checked major additions against Revision 2 goals and prior analysis: full UAR admin, authoritative catalog execution, remote MCP identity, publication coordination, and closeout are all tied to stated goals or constraints.

Constraint violations — checked planning-only hold, operator approval before execute, preservation of existing service/Compass/gateway work, six integrated boundaries without unit loops, and both essential platforms; the plan states these constraints explicitly and does not authorize production implementation.
